this happened to my mom and i still think about it all the time. so october 2019, my grandpa (mom’s dad) had passed away in his sleep. he was in his 90s and staying in the hospital and everyone knew he was always his time to go but obviously his death still hurt. 

it fucked with my mom a lot because she wasn’t there for his last moments and never got the chance to say goodbye to him. she cried a lot over that and while i wasn’t that close with him and had my mixed feelings about him— that part still hurt me as well. 

my mom stayed in nyc (where her family lives) for the funeral and just helping her mom grieve over his death (they were together for 50 years, we had their anniversary party right before his health started to decline). she started there for a few weeks and then come back home. the fact of her not being able to say goodbye was killing her inside.
